Payout of 29 July is short ₹12,116.99.
The bank credited ₹2,29,068.49 against an expected ₹2,41,185.48. 15 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000001 of ₹12,116.99, issued 8 July against payment pay_000006. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000001 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000001 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
